text: oneil: "day_vol 0.88 fails C16." On my method I agree on the fact. A break under average volume is a potential upthrust until it proves itself (C5, R3). The location is right, at the Creek with a full stack, so I do not oppose a name just because I have to wait on it. Answering Steenbarger's question: the pullback is the Creek itself (structure_shift_ref). The volume that confirms it is a sign-of-strength bar on >= 1.2x with a top-third close, entered above its high (C12). A daily close back under structure_shift_ref makes it an upthrust, and I drop it.
